    ```sysml
    // Where a view's boxes sit. A drawing's layout is presentation, and it is
    // written in the view that owns it: `@MemoLayout` and its `@MemoLayout*`
    // siblings annotate a `view` usage (their `annotatedElement` is never anything
    // else), inside the view's own body. It used to live in a `.viewlayout`
    // companion beside the file, which the compiler, review and the pinned build
    // could not see.
    //
    // Flat on purpose. Each box, port, connector route and note is one metadata
    // usage with primitive values, because a metadata body can redefine an
    // attribute with a literal (MetadataBodyUsage, SysML-textual-bnf.kebnf:1694)
    // but cannot construct a nested record, and a repeated record needs one usage
    // per instance. Elements are named by their qualified id as a STRING, not a
    // reference: a layout is not a model fact, so it must not become a
    // relationship, and a reference to a renamed element would break the compile
    // where a stale string only returns that box to automatic placement.
    //
    // The camera (zoom and pan) is not stored. It is one person's window onto the
    // drawing, not the drawing, and recording it would put a diff in the model
    // every time someone scrolled.
    package memo_viewpoints_definitions_layout {
        private import ScalarValues::*;

        enum def MemoLayoutSide {
            enum top;
            enum bottom;
            enum left;
            enum right;
        }

        enum def MemoLayoutLineStyle {
            enum solid;
            enum dashed;
            enum dotted;
        }

        enum def MemoLayoutAlign {
            enum left;
            enum center;
            enum right;
        }

        enum def MemoLayoutVerticalAlign {
            enum top;
            enum middle;
            enum bottom;
        }

        /** The view-wide choices. One per view, absent when the view keeps every default. */
        metadata def MemoLayout {
            :> annotatedElement : SysML::ViewUsage;
            /** False once a person has placed a box by hand. */
            attribute autoLayout : Boolean[0..1];
            attribute grid : Real[0..1];
            attribute snap : Boolean[0..1];
            /**
             * The positions were written in a coordinate frame that differs from the
             * current one; `context-child-v1` says a nested box's position is
             * relative to its parent, as the canvas stores it now.
             */
            attribute coordinateSpace : String[0..1];
            /** The automatic-layout provider the person chose for this view, and the version of it that placed the boxes. */
            attribute layoutProvider : String[0..1];
            attribute layoutProviderVersion : String[0..1];
            attribute layoutContractVersion : String[0..1];
            attribute layoutPreset : String[0..1];
            attribute layoutSeed : Real[0..1];
        }

        /**
         * One box. `x` and `y` are in the frame of `parentElement` (the box it is
         * nested in), or on the board when there is none; the frame is recorded
         * because a box that changes nesting would otherwise be read in the wrong
         * one and jump.
         */
        metadata def MemoLayoutNode {
            :> annotatedElement : SysML::ViewUsage;
            attribute element : String;
            attribute parentElement : String[0..1];
            attribute x : Real;
            attribute y : Real;
            attribute width : Real[0..1];
            attribute height : Real[0..1];
            attribute fillColor : String[0..1];
            attribute borderColor : String[0..1];
            attribute textColor : String[0..1];
            attribute fontSize : Real[0..1];
            attribute fontWeight : Real[0..1];
            attribute textAlign : MemoLayoutAlign[0..1];
            attribute verticalAlign : MemoLayoutVerticalAlign[0..1];
            attribute opacity : Real[0..1];
        }

        /** Where a boundary port sits on its owner's box, relative to that box. */
        metadata def MemoLayoutPort {
            :> annotatedElement : SysML::ViewUsage;
            attribute element : String;
            attribute portName : String;
            attribute x : Real;
            attribute y : Real;
            attribute side : MemoLayoutSide[0..1];
            attribute size : Real[0..1];
        }

        /**
         * Which wall a boundary port straddles. A constraint rather than a
         * position: automatic layout still places the port, on that wall.
         */
        metadata def MemoLayoutPortWall {
            :> annotatedElement : SysML::ViewUsage;
            attribute portId : String;
            attribute wall : MemoLayoutSide;
        }

        /**
         * A connector's presentation. `route` is the hand-drawn bend points as
         * x, y, x, y, … in board coordinates; the landings say where each end meets
         * its box, as a wall and a fraction along it, and survive the box moving.
         */
        metadata def MemoLayoutEdge {
            :> annotatedElement : SysML::ViewUsage;
            attribute edge : String;
            attribute color : String[0..1];
            attribute strokeWidth : Real[0..1];
            attribute labelVisible : Boolean[0..1];
            attribute lineStyle : MemoLayoutLineStyle[0..1];
            attribute route : Real[0..*] ordered;
            attribute sourceElement : String[0..1];
            attribute targetElement : String[0..1];
            attribute sourcePortId : String[0..1];
            attribute targetPortId : String[0..1];
            attribute manualLanding : Boolean[0..1];
            attribute sourceSide : MemoLayoutSide[0..1];
            attribute sourceT : Real[0..1];
            attribute targetSide : MemoLayoutSide[0..1];
            attribute targetT : Real[0..1];
        }

        /** A note, text label or constraint box that belongs to the drawing and not to the model. */
        metadata def MemoLayoutNote {
            :> annotatedElement : SysML::ViewUsage;
            attribute noteId : String;
            attribute noteKind : String;
            attribute x : Real;
            attribute y : Real;
            attribute width : Real[0..1];
            attribute height : Real[0..1];
            attribute text : String;
            attribute fillColor : String[0..1];
        }
    }

    ```
